Source links, Google Play watch, Sign-in back as a column

Every app links its source code, RL training cells link the training folder, and the nightly scan adds a Google Play link once a game's listing goes public.

What moved

  1. SOURCE A Source code link under each description. It's hidden only when the scan sees the repo answer 404 to an anonymous visitor (private): PoMemeVideo, after the next production scan.
  2. TRAINING Each RL training cell is a link to that repo's training folder: training/, Config/, config/, Training/ or Assets/Config/Training/.
  3. PLAY New scan step, "Checking source and Google Play links". It makes anonymous requests (never the GitHub token) to each repo and to each game's Play Store page by its Android package name. "Google Play" appears under a game the night after its listing is published. Today all nine return 404, so none shows.
  4. SIGN-IN A column again, not "Microsoft, except PoRepoLineTracker" in the shared line. The "all but one" summary rule is removed, since apps differ and some will drop login.
  5. FIX On phones, tapping almost anywhere in a table opened its last app: the name link's overlay covered the whole table. It now covers only its own cell, and the home page E2E test checks it.
